description: Clankerism issue taxonomy plus optional operational labels used by the merge queue.

state.name: state:ready
state.description: Available for a clanker to claim

state.name: state:in-progress
state.description: A clanker has claimed this and opened a branch

state.name: state:blocked
state.description: Waiting on a user, external dep, or upstream fix

state.name: state:stale
state.description: No movement for > staleness window — needs triage

operational_labels.name: queue:ready
operational_labels.description: PR is ready for serialized merge-queue validation on latest main

operational_labels.name: queue:active
operational_labels.description: Queue runner is currently validating this PR

operational_labels.name: queue:deferred
operational_labels.description: PR is ready, but waiting behind an older open PR in the same lock group

operational_labels.name: queue:blocked
operational_labels.description: Queue failed or refused this PR; refresh/fix before re-queueing
